question: L, M, N, O, P, and Q are seated around a round table, facing the center. Q sits second to the right of O. L sits second to the left of N. M is adjacent to the immediate left of Q. Who sits adjacent to the immediate right of P?
solution:
Given:

 

L, M, N, O, P, and Q are seated around a round table, facing the center.

Q sits second to the right of O.

M is adjacent to the immediate left of Q. 

L sits second to the left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753295e132d8303e114175720a32e58bfbf03b2a4158d2a817136a77f59d522d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2909f7e9e91223ab21b082de6a4eadfeb3330f73a0e02463ee8663d23ddd7de7.png] 

Thus, N sits adjacent to the immediate right of P

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
